api-backend:
Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities at 81f05a2b
|-- Request entry
|   `-- handleAgentRoutes -> AgentDiagrammingSessionService.call()/callBound()
|       |-- agentToolSchemas validation; requestId deduplication/conflict checks
|       |-- ChatCanvasBindings: capture target/access; inject matching sessionId
|       |-- CanvasReadAliases / CanvasApiProjection: resolve read-scoped handles
|       `-- Route reads, execution, direct submissions and lifecycle operations
|-- Execute diagram changes
|   |-- QuickJsAgentRuntime.run(): restricted canvas/nodes/edges JavaScript
|   |   |-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService.exec(): resolve attachment and methods
|   |   |-- Batched mode: buffer consecutive DiagramOperation values
|   |   |   |-- Flush before canvas.*, node/edge reads, setSourceMappings/setJumps
|   |   |   |-- Successful script end flushes remaining operations
|   |   |   |-- One atomic apply/undo checkpoint per flush
|   |   |   `-- Failure leaves prior flushes committed; pending tail is unapplied
|   |   |-- applyBatch(): final-state receipts and resulting version
|   |   |   `-- Queued handles enable dependent writes; they are not receipts
|   |   |-- Immediate mode: apply each edit; return projected node results
|   |   `-- expectedVersion matches initial version; each apply guards next version
|   |       `-- Timeout retry replays results; resends unacknowledged IDs/versions
|   |-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService.apply()/applyBatch(): select target
|   |   |-- Isolated proposal -> ChangeSessionService.apply()
|   |   |   `-- MappingDocumentController checks version, applies, persists preview
|   |   `-- GenerationCanvasBridge: CanvasSessionPort shared by agent and chat
|   |       |-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService / LiveCanvasService dispatch here
|   |       |-- Browser target -> CanvasSessionBridge.dispatch()
|   |       |   `-- Queue command -> browser handleAgentCommand -> poll/reply result
|   |       `-- Managed child: owns controller, history, queue and retry receipts
|   |           |-- AgentChatService calls add/history/remove for child lifetime
|   |           |-- Headless reads and guarded apply/revision/batch/context edits
|   |           |-- Persist exported history through AgentChat's callback
|   |           `-- Limited view/checkpoint support; parent owns fork management
|   |-- DiagramEditService: prompt generation or supplied candidate
|   |   |-- generateDiagram OR submitStoredDiagramEdit validates/retains revision
|   |   |-- In-place or variant; whole diagram or revision-pinned subtrees
|   |   |-- create/extend use pinned anchors, references and optional context
|   |   |-- Track progress/cancel before application; retain result for retry
|   |   `-- Canvas port applies revision/creations and awaits persistence
|   |-- DiagramBatchService: called by agent.call() / submitDirect()
|   |   |-- One base snapshot; reject repeated edits to the same shared diagram
|   |   |-- Prepare all supplied/generated results before one atomic application
|   |   `-- One persisted undo step; retry acknowledgement without regeneration
|   `-- Revision and publication boundaries
|       |-- Pure revision operations return immutable values
|       |-- Revision store retains/imports issued revisions explicitly
|       `-- Controller installs revisions and records history; catalog save is separate
|-- Read and synchronize live state
|   |-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService.search()/snapshot()
|   |   |-- Live/managed target -> bridge; isolated target -> ChangeSessionService
|   |   `-- Saved target -> representation catalog
|   |-- currentCanvasRead(): selected current state, without history
|   |   |-- Small: text, anchors, source evidence, highlight/jump status, collapse
|   |   `-- Full: geometry, other objects, edges/view; aliases projected at API edge
|   |-- LiveCanvasService
|   |   |-- Publisher registration/disconnection; selection snapshots/deltas
|   |   |-- Reader attachment/invalidation by document and canvasEpoch
|   |   |-- Fresh nodes/edges/version; context()/contextForCanvas()/shortContextForCanvas()
|   |   `-- Copy/paste dispatch; paste checks expectedVersion
|   `-- Agent context
|       |-- AgentContextService: validate reader; store uploaded edit trajectory
|       |-- AgentContextLibrary: called by agent tools and AgentChatService
|       |   `-- Create/list/read immutable saved contexts via file repository/sources
|       `-- Diagram context store: disk evidence plus versioned diagram binding
|-- Manage proposals and durable state
|   |-- ChangeSessionService: proposal lifecycle
|   |   |-- Capture isolated saved canvases/live drafts; pin repository/commits/hunks
|   |   |-- Metadata, DiffTree/migrations, review state, undo/redo/reset
|   |   `-- Accept: check session version/originals; publish together; retain review
|   |-- Diagram publication: AgentDiagrammingSessionService.save() -> saveNow()
|   |   |-- Serialize per document; reject save_diagram for ChangeSession previews
|   |   |-- Whole document: bridge checkpoint -> MappingDiagramService.publishCheckpoint()
|   |   |-- One diagram: snapshot/version check -> isolated history -> diagrams.save()
|   |   `-- Notify browser with saved receipt; report displayUpdated separately
|   `-- MappingWorkspaceService: called by workspace routes
|       |-- loadRecords()/applyBatch(): atomic incremental records
|       `-- load()/save(): reconstructed/full snapshots; persist referenced revisions
`-- Run application features
    |-- AgentChatService: AgentChatPanel / GenerateAlternatives / bound chat tools
    |   |-- Own chats, turns, captured canvas/references, bindings and tool snapshots
    |   |-- StdioCodexConnection: create/resume, send, stream, interrupt, answer
    |   |-- MappingChatMcpBinding binds each turn; LiveCanvasService reads context
    |   |-- ChatDiagramTools -> agent.submitDirect() -> DiagramBatchService
    |   |   `-- Validate references/base revisions; supplied ASCII; atomic operations[]
    |   |-- ChatDiagramTools also dispatches views, contexts, highlights, projections
    |   |-- genAlternatives(): pin saved view; launch independent managed child chats
    |   |   |-- Inherit settings/tools; fork parent thread or inject saved AgentContext
    |   |   `-- GenerationCanvasBridge owns each child's isolated editable canvas
    |   |-- Own cancellation, status/usage, request receipts and parent synchronization
    |   |   |-- Persist child result first; sync finished history to parent view
    |   |   `-- Parent capture/update uses live browser; reconnect retries pending save
    |   `-- FileChatStore: serialized atomic file replacement for chats/child histories
    |-- DiffSessionWorkflowService: mapping routes / PushIntegrationService
    |   `-- Capture pinned context -> analyze/materialize -> ready proposal; persist runs
    |-- PushIntegrationService: mapping integration callers
    |   `-- Persist/deduplicate push events; GitPushSource -> DiffSessionWorkflowService
    |-- SelectionService: /prompt generation/patch
    |-- LocalChatService: /chat local chat
    |-- FileCompactionService: /compactions run/get
    `-- MappingDiagramService: /diagrams save/delete
